notes: Posted 24 July 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted under 'Start (10)' beside the Objective: Endor: Chief Chirpa's Hut, Endor: Landing Platform (Docking Bay), Tatooine: Podrace Arena, Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight, Luke's Lightsaber, Anakin's Podracer, Boonta Eve Podrace, Seeking An Audience, I Feel The Conflict and Podrace Prep; these count toward the 60.
Posted 'Echo Command Centre' dested Hoth: Echo Command Center (War Room), the War Room the Objective deploys; 'Home OneWar Room' Home One: War Room.

Posted 'Artoo' dested Artoo (Jabba's Palace) (Artoo, Brave Little Droid is a later Theed Palace card); 'EPP Han', 'EPP Leia' and 'EPP Obi-Wan' dested Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol, Leia With Blaster Rifle and Obi-Wan With Lightsaber; 'Lando w/ Ax' Lando With Vibro-Ax; 'Wedge Antilles RSL' Wedge Antilles, Red Squadron Leader; 'Chewie, Protector' Chewbacca, Protector.

Posted 'Shocking Info & Grimtaash' and 'SorryAbout TheMess&Blaster Proficiency' dested the Reflections II combos Shocking Information & •Grimtaash and Sorry About The Mess & •Blaster Proficiency; 'A Step Backwards' A Step Backward; 'I Did It' I Did It!; 'Draw Thier Fire' Draw Their Fire.
The strategy credits the design to Brett Chaiyawatt, who played it undefeated in (unnamed) tournament play; no event or finish is given for this list, so it stays a general deck.
